verdict.rationale: TrueLayer publishes extensive public API documentation covering Payments API v3, Data API, Verification API, webhooks, signing, and SDKs for Node.js/Python/Java/.NET, with a quickstart for making a test payment — clear evidence of a documented, programmatically drivable API for an AI-native or any developer user. Missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (probe found only 404s), so full API surface must be inferred from prose docs rather than a formal schema.
